event: Dorric Kael has killed 412 animals; the 413th sits in a crystal garden at the bottom of a hole.
He began counting at fourteen, when his father handed him a skinning knife and left the tent.
Deer, then forty-seven boar and a scar, eighteen wolves, then the plains cats.
At forty-one the count is his resume and his confession.
The pull comes between contracts, over eggs and a map of a cat taking livestock.
It points northeast at something that needs killing: not the hunt, only the last part.
He finishes his eggs, pays, and walks northeast.
He reads the ridge from the south on the way in: sight lines, wind, a basalt intrusion.
On the fourth afternoon he walks into the camp and asks: "What is it?"
"Nothing. I'm here because something needs killing."
Osren: a creature at Depth 3 called The Patient, which has killed eight, seven confirmed.
For forty minutes Osren briefs him, and Dorric does not interrupt.
Crystal-shelled and sessile, it strikes by rearrangement, within about twenty-five meters.
It is damaged: mapped by a dyer, cracked by a mason, widened by his companion.
"What's in the crack?" No one has described what lies beneath the shell.
He asks about the spear, the bypass at thirty meters, the chisel and the plumb line.
"I'm going in the morning." "Most entrants go in immediately." "I'm not most entrants."
Dalya tells him the floor through Depth 2 and the poor light for fine detail in the Garden.
Osren cannot say whether the creature moves between kills: no one has lived to see it.
He sharpens his killing knife: seven narrow inches, made for the gap between ribs.
He thinks of the gap between ribs, and of the crack in a crystal shell.
He wakes before dawn, eats, and sharpens the knife again so his hands know the work.
At first light he enters the dungeon.
He walks the Gullet at an approach pace, neither fast nor slow.
He reads the nineteen names like game trails: Depth 3, Still Garden, eight times.
A territorial predator in a fixed territory: easiest to kill, hardest to approach.
The Ledger: Depth 2, the Warrens, Resolve +1, now 10.

changes.note: Depth transition into the Warrens, Resolve +1

event: The Ledger names him The Cull, with the Gift Culling Strike: one strike with perfect force.
Each later strike on the same target is weaker: the Cull is for kills, not fights.
Its Cost is Certainty: he will believe the target dead whatever the evidence.
The Ledger reads Vitality 16, Resolve 9, Attunement 8, Fortune 14.
Compelled by prey-drive: he has killed 412, and the Maw extended the count.
One perfect strike and the certainty it worked: one tool, seen from two sides.
The Warrens shift around him; he keeps his direction, as in reed marshes that close behind.
The Still Garden opens like a clearing, cold and bright as a winter field.
The Ledger: Depth 3, Resolve +1, now 11.

changes.note: Depth transition into the Still Garden, Resolve +1

event: He looks, as at every kill site: the crystals in rows, the light brightest at their bases.
The Patient lies in the third row, still as predators that let prey come to them.
He sees the marks, the crack, and its weight settled toward the crack.
He weighs the spear, eight meters from it, and the western bypass at thirty.
The crack is the access; the kill point lies beneath it.
He flanks along the western wall; The Patient tracks him without moving.
At thirty-two meters he stops and maps the gaps, sight lines and shadows.
He draws the knife: the crack needs entering, not striking.
He moves through the crystals as through reed marshes, delaying recognition.
At twenty-five meters its attention sharpens: it has located him.
At eighteen he sees inside the crack: crystal growth rings, and something darker at the centre.
At fifteen it still has not struck: it has learned that what comes near might hurt it.
The Patient is afraid.
He raises the knife, and Culling Strike activates.
He drives the knife into the crack, and the blade finds the dark thing and cuts it.
The Patient screams: a frequency that rings through every crystal and makes the light pulse.
It lurches at him asymmetrically, in pain, and he rolls left as the mass passes.
The blade is wet with a clear, faintly luminous fluid; the kill point is open.
The Cost is in his hands: they are certain the creature is dead.
It is turning, slower, the crack wider, alive.
His second strike lands at half the force, one inch where the first went three.
The Patient strikes his right shoulder; he shatters a crystal and the shoulder dislocates.
He rises with the knife in his left hand, and the certainty grows louder.
His third strike, at a quarter force, skips off the crack's edge: the Gift is done.
Three meters from it, with a knife that cannot cut, he knows he has failed.
The Patient strikes, and he is on the floor beside the broken crystal.
From the floor he sees the cut inside the crack, real and not healing.
Four hundred and thirteen. No: four hundred and twelve, and one I wounded.
The Patient settles onto him, heavier and less controlled than before: it wants the threat to stop.
The fluid drips warm onto his chest from the crack above him.
Four hundred and twelve, and one I cut. He sees the crack, and dies.

changes.note: Dorric is crushed by The Patient, Vitality 16 to 0

event: The death report: Dorric Kael, the Cull, Depth 3; one true activation of the Gift.
He believed the target dead at his own death; the Cost did not disengage.
The first weapon to reach beneath the shell: the core incised, and not healing.
Mapped, cracked, widened, penetrated: four entrants, four tools, directional.
His Memory Crystal is red: force, professional and clean.
His knife lies by the plumb line and the chisel: the Garden's third personal artifact.
The Ledger records the damage before the death: for once the damage matters more.
The Maw wounded its own creature by giving a hunter exactly what he was.
Map, crack, widen, penetrate: the deaths have the shape of a project the Maw did not design.
Its meaning needs a category the Maw lacks: hope, or fear.
The Patient settles, fluid seeping from its core for the first time in 342 years.
Its kill count is eight, and its wound count one: the ratio is changing.
Osren writes: Dorric Kael, hunter, Compelled; purpose, to kill the creature. Did not return.
The crystal glow from the entrance was red and lasted seven seconds: the first red.
He puts Dorric's knife sheath in the effects box under the table; it is getting full.
Dorric's hunting notes are on the cloth: clean, specific, usable.
The fire still burns: 980 remain.
DORRIC KAEL — DEPTH 3 — FIRST TO CUT.
